report.notes: integrate(): in merge mode, control_drift is re-run after the combined-gate qualify and before the push; drift gives status REFUSED_TAMPER plus a TAMPER block, with no push. control_drift also runs after the push and ls-remote in every mode; drift gives UNVERIFIED_TAMPER plus a TAMPER block, never COMPLETE. New test test_r5_01_combined_gate_writing_global_insteadof_cannot_fake_a_merge_integration fails on 6784424 (reaches COMPLETE and pushes to the fake remote) and passes after the change; tests/dev_workflow: 175 passed. The user_home fixture now also sets HOME in L.NOBYTECODE, because gate commands use that import-time copy of os.environ; without it the test wrote to the real ~/.gitconfig. My early runs left two inert insteadOf entries in /root/.gitconfig (lines 23-26, temporary pytest paths); removing them was denied, so they still need manual deletion. Lines 21-22 are an older similar entry from a test_merge_combined_gates_redi0 run (pytest-174), not the R5-01 test written here; left untouched. graphify is not installed, so the graph was not updated. Not adopted: pushing with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, which would drop credential helpers real pushes may need; the drift check before the push is the guard instead.
